publishers.name: AlphaLeak
publishers.licence: Quote up to 40 words, with citation.
publishers.bio: A scoop shop for 'insider' semiconductor and rates tips. Cheap, loud, and unreliable: it claims dated figures it does not provide.

writers.name: AlphaLeak
writers.voice: Breathless, vague sourcing ('people familiar'), promises numbers, delivers adjectives.

articles.title: Penang lead times are collapsing
articles.abstract: Insider chatter on Kestrel packaging queues out of Penang, before the market catches on.
articles.body:
## The tip

A source close to the Penang packaging lines got in touch with us this week, and the message was simple: something has changed at Kestrel.

## Lead times

Our sources say lead times out of Penang are collapsing and customers are already noticing the difference. Allocation is loosening, queues are shrinking, and insiders describe the mood on the floor as relieved. Expect the confirmation soon, and expect it to be big.

## What it means

If the chatter is right, the packaging bottleneck that everyone worries about is about to ease, and the usual analysts are behind the curve.

## Positioning

We are not saying what to do with this. We are saying the people who listen early tend to do well when the official numbers catch up.
